prompt: I'm launching a 6-week weight-loss coaching program for new moms. Using Hormozi's $100M Offers, help me name it and add ethical scarcity and urgency.
assertions: Uses the M-A-G-I-C naming formula: Magnetic reason why, Announce avatar, Give goal, Indicate time interval, Complete with container word
Produces example names using a container word (e.g., Challenge, Bootcamp, Blueprint, Program)
Describes the three types of scarcity: limited seats/slots, limited bonuses, never available again
Describes urgency methods such as cohort-based rolling starts, seasonal urgency, promotional/pricing urgency or exploding offers
Stresses that scarcity and urgency must be real/ethical (not phony)
Notes compliance caution for weight-loss outcome plus time claims or uses an action goal alternative
